load_kernel_local: load a kernel module from a local Python module by name using importlib
load_kernel_hub_fallback: load a kernel from a Hugging Face Hub repo when the local module is not found
load_kernel_with_repo: load a kernel by module name with a fallback repo_id for Hub kernels
review_load_kernel: review the load_kernel function to understand its local-first Hub-fallback loading strategy
refactor_load_kernel: refactor load_kernel to support additional fallback strategies beyond local and Hub
